about_the_game:
AIO —— Your Screen, with AI by Your Side

A cute desktop pet named AIO sits quietly at the edge of your screen.

It can “see” what’s on your display: English webpages, game scenes, work documents… and instantly offers witty comments, accurate translations, or personalized replies that you set yourself.

No need to switch apps or copy-paste—AIO recognizes in real time and responds immediately, like a permanent screen companion that makes every click more fun and efficient.

Core Features

Real-time Screen Recognition: Instantly reads on-screen content, multi-language supported.

One-click Translation: Select English text, and AIO pops up with Chinese meaning.

Custom System Prompts: Let the pet speak in your style—gentle, sarcastic, professional, as you wish.

Live & Die Together: When the game closes, AIO and its Flask service exit simultaneously, zero background residue.

Lightweight & Transparent: Borderless, transparent, never blocks your view, no extra window.

Use Cases

Browsing foreign pages or English docs—highlight to translate.

Want your game screenshot roasted like a “tieba bro”? AIO speaks anytime.

Need a permanent screen assistant? AIO is always online, always cute.

​

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
